evaluation.success_criterion: all collected tests in the per-task test file pass (min_pass_rate=1.0); ADAPTED STRICTER than CTA unit_test_runner: skipped, collection errors, per-test errors, and zero tests are NOT success; environment/evaluator failures -> invalid, excluded from success/fail coverage
evaluation.test_staging: CTA eval.py copies the test file (and _dependency_utils.py when present) to /tmp/benchmark_tests/ inside the container and rewrites test_command accordingly; tests reference the repo via REPO_DIR=/workspace/python.
evaluation.test_visibility: acceptance tests are staged only at evaluation time; they are not in the agent workspace
evaluation.result_source: JUnit XML (counts, failed names, duration) cross-checked against pytest exit code; terminal 'passed' string is not parsed

outcomes.success: all collected tests pass, pytest exit 0, junit consistent
outcomes.fail: test failures, skips, collection/test errors, or task timeout (task_timeout is a fixed protocol fail, distinct from infra timeout)
outcomes.invalid: setup_failure | runner_error | evaluator_error | zero_tests_collected | exit_xml_contradiction — excluded from success/fail coverage

adaptation_differences: CTA unit_test_runner parses the summary line and may pass a run with skips; this adapter treats skip as not-success (batch10 coverage test would otherwise silently pass).
Environment/infra/evaluator failures -> invalid (not counted as task failure and not as success).
Tests run from /tmp/benchmark_tests with -o addopts= and PYTHONPATH cleared to avoid project pytest config pollution.
JUnit XML is authoritative; pytest exit code cross-checked.
